query.text: 请帮我照看家里的孩子，有危险及时通知我。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the children at home and notify me immediately if there is any danger.

annotation.text_zh: 宝宝靠近阳台门了，请注意看护。
annotation.text_en: The baby is near the balcony door, please keep an eye on them.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
